title: King Center undergraduate research programs and current calls
acquisitionMethod: Manual review of public official HTML and each linked SOLO opportunity.
provenFormat: Public HTML pages with project titles, mentor names, and explicit cycle/deadline text; linked SOLO pages hold applications.
machineFeedStatus: No documented official opportunity feed or API verified in this research.
possibleAutomation: An HTML change detector could queue new or changed project links for editorial review; this is a proposed path, not an existing integration.
reviewCadence: Weekly; twice weekly around Autumn and Winter application periods.
filtering: Undergraduate program calls only. Exclude graduate, predoctoral, postdoctoral, and faculty funding; check each project's skills and enrollment rules.
expiryChecks: Read project-specific deadline and timezone. Close dated calls after expiry even if they remain under Current Opportunities. Never infer a new cycle from a reused URL.
notes: Current AY2026–27 calls were due October 6 or 11; all had passed. Summer page explicitly identifies 2027 but has no project list or deadline yet.

title: Ronald I. McKinnon Memorial Fellowship
acquisitionMethod: Manual review of the official program page and any newly published call.
provenFormat: Public HTML eligibility and application guidance.
machineFeedStatus: No documented feed or API verified.
possibleAutomation: Monitor the Application Deadline section for changes and send changed text to a review queue.
reviewCadence: Monthly; weekly during Winter and Spring.
filtering: Stanford undergraduate honors-thesis support. Prefer proposals with a substantive economic-development question.
expiryChecks: Require an explicit date and cycle before displaying Open. A blank deadline heading is not evidence of rolling admission.
notes: Deadline heading is blank on the reviewed page; seed is an Explore program record.

title: SIEPR Undergraduate Research Fellows
acquisitionMethod: Manual review of project headings, Open position labels, quarter dates, and the linked official application form.
provenFormat: Public HTML with project-level status, descriptions, qualifications, and a linked Smartsheet form.
machineFeedStatus: No official feed/API verified. The application form is an application destination, not a listing API.
possibleAutomation: A page-diff parser could queue additions and status changes; human review must still determine development relevance and undergraduate fit.
reviewCadence: At least weekly, and immediately before promoting an undated opening.
filtering: Only undergraduate roles whose research directly addresses development, inequality, public institutions, health, education, environment, or economic opportunity. Exclude generic economics/data roles without that connection.
expiryChecks: Check the current quarter, project status, and form destination. Undated Open records should lose their Open label if not reverified within seven days; never treat program end as application deadline.
notes: Brazil vocational education is explicitly listed as Open in Autumn 2026. A separate King Center route with the same mentor has an expired deadline, so application routes need separate status checks.

title: SIG international fellowships and application information
acquisitionMethod: Manual review of SIG's official listings, host pages, cycle guidance, and linked SOLO calls.
provenFormat: Public HTML program and placement pages; linked SOLO application calls.
possibleAutomation: Monitor international placement links and annual call text, then queue changes for approval. Do not automatically copy every SIG host.
reviewCadence: Every two weeks in Autumn; weekly December–February.
filtering: Select individual development-relevant hosts and duties. Check continuing-undergraduate, coterm, nationality, language, clearance, and skills requirements at placement level.
expiryChecks: Use the cycle-specific SOLO call as the application authority. Flag conflicting years or timelines for manual resolution; do not repair them by guessing.
notes: The application page mixes a December 22, 2026 release with expired January/February 2026 deadlines. No 2027 deadline is asserted in the seed.

title: SIG self-arranged policy internship stipends
acquisitionMethod: Manual review of the annual stipend guidance and linked current SOLO call.
provenFormat: Public HTML eligibility and annual deadlines.
possibleAutomation: Monitor annual deadline and application-link changes, with an editor checking year and placement requirements.
reviewCadence: Monthly; weekly during Winter and Spring application rounds.
filtering: Funding for self-arranged development-policy work only. Direct service or general nonprofit employment is not automatically eligible under SIG's policy criteria.
expiryChecks: Close each round at its published deadline. Keep evergreen program separate from dated calls and do not imply that SIG supplies the placement.
notes: 2026 deadlines February 16 and April 14 are past; next-cycle dates were not verified.

title: FSI Global Policy Internships
acquisitionMethod: Manual review of FSI's program and each official current SOLO placement.
provenFormat: Public HTML program overview and eligibility; placement links lead to official opportunity pages.
possibleAutomation: Capture new linked SOLO calls as draft candidates; review host requirements and development relevance before approval.
filtering: Allow undergraduate-accessible development-policy placements. Exclude graduate-only hosts, security-policy roles without a development connection, and positions with incompatible enrollment requirements.
expiryChecks: Require a dated current-cycle call. The program landing page and FAQ describe different typical closing windows; specific placement deadlines take precedence.
notes: Program accepts students at all levels but individual host requirements vary. A general annual window is not a verified 2027 deadline.

title: Global Studies Internship Program
acquisitionMethod: Manual review of official SOLO open/closed listings and the SGS eligibility/application pages.
provenFormat: Public HTML with Open now/coming soon and Closed & recurring categories, plus opportunity detail links.
machineFeedStatus: No documented RSS/API verified; visible HTML categories are not a feed guarantee.
possibleAutomation: A permitted HTML monitor could queue newly open detail links; an editor must inspect the host, duties, undergraduate requirements, and current cycle.
reviewCadence: Every two weeks in Autumn; weekly December–February.
filtering: Choose only development, health, education, rights, environment, or public-institutions roles. Exclude unrelated business, arts, or technology placements despite their international location.
expiryChecks: Require an open current-cycle detail page and verify enrollment through funding/internship. Expire archived January/February 2026 calls; remote status must be verified per position.
notes: Reviewed SOLO page reports zero open/coming-soon positions and 52 closed/recurring entries.

title: Human Rights Summer Fellowship
acquisitionMethod: Manual review of the official program page and dated SGS/SOLO call.
provenFormat: Public HTML program requirements and dated application pages.
possibleAutomation: Monitor the program application link and new annual SGS/SOLO calls; review discrepancies before copying award amounts or requirements.
filtering: Undergraduate-eligible human-rights and international-justice work with a clear community or development connection. Require applicable course prerequisites and host support.
expiryChecks: Read a current-year deadline. Do not label an undated evergreen page Open or reuse February 10, 2026 for a later cycle.
notes: Evergreen page retains old COVID wording and differs from the 2026 call on stipend amount. Public seed omits the amount and treats it as a planning resource.

title: International Public Service and African Service fellowships
acquisitionMethod: Manual review of the official SOLO program, current call, and Cardinal Quarter eligibility guidance.
provenFormat: Public HTML program pages with open/closed counts and links to current opportunity calls.
possibleAutomation: Queue newly opened program calls from SOLO, then review eligibility and dates. Track African Service as a related funding track to avoid duplicate application claims.
filtering: Continuing-undergraduate development/public-service projects only. Assess the community-defined work and proposed partner rather than treating all international travel as development.
expiryChecks: Use the current call, not evergreen program boilerplate, for deadline, stipend, travel, and student-year rules. Mark old-cycle calls closed even if still linked.
notes: Both reviewed program pages have zero open opportunities. Official pages disagree on older stipend amounts; seed omits amounts.

title: UNV Online Volunteering
acquisitionMethod: Manual review of official program rules; discover individual assignments in the official Unified Volunteering Platform.
provenFormat: Public official HTML eligibility guidance; official assignment platform.
machineFeedStatus: No documented official feed/API verified. Direct HTML collection returned HTTP 403 during validation; review this source in the browser.
possibleAutomation: Investigate an official export/feed or agreed partner intake before building an importer. Until then, manually enter selected assignments with their own evidence and deadlines.
reviewCadence: Program rules monthly; any promoted individual assignment at least weekly and immediately before featuring.
filtering: Online assignments accepting applicants aged 18+ whose skills and education requirements allow undergraduates. Exclude degree/experience-restricted professional assignments and unrelated communications tasks.
expiryChecks: Individual assignments require their own current deadline/status; a live platform does not make every listed assignment open. Preserve unpaid status and avoid presenting it as UN employment.
notes: Seed is an Explore program portal and claims no particular available assignment.
